CustomMetadata.label: Nonprofit Cloud Gifts and Soft Credits

values.value: Copies Nonprofit Cloud campaigns, gift designations, gift commitments, paid gift transactions and gift soft credits into BarnCRM Giving, in this org. Each gift keeps its Gift Transaction ID, so the Gift Transaction mirror never copies it back. Nonprofit Cloud itself is never changed.
